variants.note: regression (round 3): the pre-pass (DATA objects) and cycle collapse must not change any verdict

expect.note: the small capture is stored in place; after -O2 the manager and invoker calls are direct and inlined

expected alloc before the first run; clang -O2 elides the new/delete pair of the heap-stored capture ([expr.new] allows it) and folds the call. The -fsanitize=realtime build with [[clang::nonblocking]] keeps them (the RealtimeSanitizer comparison analyses that build), and so does -fno-builtin: see the variant

the invoker is called through a pointer of type i32(ptr, ptr): every address-taken _M_invoke of that type is a target. Expected 3 before the first run; at -O2 the two in build_small/build_big are inlined away, so only main's lambda is address-taken
